column22: Roblox takes steps to prevent users from disclosing or requesting personal information on Roblox (outside of Trusted Connections, designed for users they know and trust). This includes real names, home addresses, phone numbers, passwords, and financial or medical information.

Roblox may take action against users for behavior that occurs outside of the platform if it poses a high risk to the community. This includes predatory behavior, recruitment to illegal or extremist organizations, and credible threats of real-world violence.

Roblox prohibits threats of physical harm in the real world. This includes direct or indirect threats against individuals, groups of people, or specific locations, as well as the glorification of violent acts.

Roblox prohibits the depiction of political figures in their official capacity, including current or recent government officials and candidates for office. It also prohibits content related to political parties, campaign materials, and the desecration of political symbols.

Roblox prohibits the creation or promotion of scams, including "free Robux" schemes, phishing, and the sale of fraudulent items. It also prohibits the use of third-party software or exploits to gain an unfair advantage in experiences.

Roblox prohibits attempts to bypass platform safety systems, exploit technical vulnerabilities, or gain unauthorized access to accounts. It specifically includes enforcement evasion, where a user creates new accounts to bypass a ban.

Roblox prohibits the sale of accounts, experiences, or items for real-world currency (Real Money Trading). It also prohibits using the platform for money laundering or engaging in simulated or real-world gambling using Robux.

Roblox prohibits the distribution of repetitive, unsolicited, or unwanted messages. This includes flooding the chat, "copy-paste" messages, commercial advertisements, and creating multiple experiences for the purpose of manipulating search results.

Roblox prohibits content that recreates, mocks, or glorifies real-world sensitive events, which include mass acts of violence, natural disasters, human rights violations, and inflammatory content regarding real-world border disputes.

Under the Illegal and Regulated Goods and Activities Community Standard, experiences may not offer real-world prizes or Robux as rewards for contests or sweepstakes. All promotions must comply with legal requirements and cannot be used to manipulate platform engagement metrics like "likes" or "visits."

Under the Misusing Roblox Systems Community Standard, Roblox prohibits the upload or use of audio intended to be disruptive or annoying. This includes "ear-bleed" audio, excessively loud screaming, unintelligible high-pitched noises, or audio designed to ruin the experience for other users.
